source_binding.fields_used: B_rows: form,value,type,denotation. No positions or target frequency vectors.

claim_ceiling: This is a conservative pool cover for a necessary inequality, not a complete semantic equality logic or a quotient of the frozen denotations. Added pooling only weakens the test. A pooled pair must never be cited as an established synonym, changed source atom, or equality after reference resolution.

mathematical_audit.condition: For every shared exact word w, there must exist at least one B pool P with b_P >= b_w and a_P >= a_w.
mathematical_audit.b_P: Count all B source realization POSITIONS belonging to any B entry in P, counting each source position once.
mathematical_audit.a_P: Count the UNION of A source realization positions whose whole A entry has any allowed compatibility edge to any B entry in P. An A position with several qualifying edges counts once.
mathematical_audit.proof: In a hypothetical shared context-free wordmap, all B realizations of w have one unchanged full denotation v. A pool covering every possibly identical B entry of v therefore contains all b_w B positions. Every one of the a_w A source positions realizing w has that same v and hence an allowed edge to the relevant B entry in this pool. Both capacity inequalities follow. Aliases do not affect the argument.
mathematical_audit.relaxations: A neighbors may retain different full values from one another; all B values in a pool need not actually be equal; different words may independently reuse the same capacity in this necessary check. No A quotient, joint allocation, transitivity or injectivity is asserted.
mathematical_audit.precondition: A genuine full identity must not be split across every available pool. The listed deliberately broad pools protect the identified B-internal ambiguities. All other separation retains explicit whole-content/reference conditions.
mathematical_audit.outputs: An empty domain for any shared word excludes the frozen complete one-word/one-denotation realization contract if both source covers are accepted. Nonempty domains for all words are only NO_DECISION; no shared map, clause grammar or translation follows.

pools.reason: The whole includes a two-food drying similarity relation, not merely DRY or generic effect.

pools.label: EXPLANATORY_RELATION
pools.reason: Conservative common explanation/cause pool: causal direction, quoted explanandum and reason placement are not formalized as incompatible full operators. This pool does not assert identity or permit altering the entries.

pools.label: DULL
pools.reason: The whole is dulling of the supplied faculty; a generic bad quality or urinary effect has different content.

pools.label: TO
pools.reason: Directed effect/output-recipient relation differs from ownership/profile OF and causal relation; no common denotation is licensed by having two arguments.

pools.label: SIGHT
pools.reason: Visual faculty is explicitly distinct from a physical eye and nourishment.

pools.label: UNLESS
pools.reason: Guarded exception qualifies a claim; it is not unary NOT, copular application, or assertion of the opposite result.

pools.label: WHOLE_EYE
pools.reason: Whole physical eye referent differs from visual faculty and human body; its whole-object scope is retained.

pools.label: UNNATURALLY
pools.reason: Modifier of abnormal attribution is not generic BAD, MOIST or an opposite-nature operator.

pools.label: IS
pools.reason: The second copula is explicitly an exact synonym with subject supplied by syntax.

pools.label: MOIST
pools.reason: A moisture attribute; comparison, abnormality and nourishment are separate arguments/values.

pools.label: BOTH_FOODS
pools.reason: Topic food pair, not logical conjunction or either individual named food.

pools.label: FOOD_CONSEQUENCE_PROFILE
pools.reason: Deliberately broad safety pool. EFFECT explicitly is not identical to NOURISHMENT: one is a generic domain-selected consequence/profile and the other a nourishment profile. Pooling them is an intentional extra relaxation of this necessary capacity condition, not an assertion that their full denotations coincide or that their atoms may change.

pools.label: CABBAGE
pools.reason: Named food-kind constant remains separate from all deictic/predicate references before application.

pools.label: MORE
pools.reason: Strict comparison differs from bare MANY/MUCH amount, second-comparator completion, and general relation.

pools.label: THAN
pools.reason: Comparison completion with a comparator is not the full strict-comparison operator.

pools.label: LENTIL
pools.reason: Both entries explicitly denote the same lentil/lentil-soup food kind.

pools.label: OF
pools.reason: Dependent profile/food ownership relation; directed recipient TO is a different semantic role.

pools.label: LITTLE
pools.reason: Low nourishment amount contrasts with MUCH; no numerical thresholds or new identification are added.

pools.label: FOOD_NOMINAL_REFERENCE
pools.reason: THIS_FOOD and THIS_VEGETABLE are deictic food references with a restriction difference. VEGETABLE expressly allows nominal use identifying the active vegetable. Pool all three conservatively despite predicate/reference and restriction differences. Do not merge the bare CABBAGE constant after resolving C.

pools.label: NOT
pools.reason: All four entries explicitly denote ordinary propositional NOT as exact synonyms; occurrence scope is construction-specific.

pools.label: SOLID_FOOD
pools.reason: Food-category predicate explicitly contrasted with vegetable status in the same source claim.

pools.label: AND
pools.reason: Binary propositional conjunction, not the food-pair reference or a universal quantifier over a supplied group.

pools.label: BODY
pools.reason: Human recipient body is explicitly not the eye alone or a food body.

pools.label: MUCH
pools.reason: Considerable nourishment amount differs from LITTLE and from the relational strict-comparison MORE.

pools.label: THICK_AND_MELANCHOLIC
pools.reason: Paid two-property compound, not generic BAD or either latent adjective in isolation.

pools.label: GOOD_JUICED
pools.reason: Whole good-intrinsic-juice predicate, not a generic good value, nourishment or the negation operator.

pools.label: BAD
pools.reason: Generic bound entity/profile bad-quality predicate, not specific urinary harm, smell, or Boolean negation.

pools.label: FOUL_SMELLING
pools.reason: Smell predicate, not generic BAD or an effect on the body.

pools.label: LETTUCE
pools.reason: The second entry explicitly preserves the same lettuce food kind.

pools.label: CAN_STATE_MANIFEST
pools.reason: Reportability capacity includes author, proposition and manifest-result qualification; SPEAK alone lacks those conditions.

pools.label: URINARY_BENEFIT
pools.reason: Manifest beneficial urinary consequence is a whole specific predicate, not generic profile selection or arbitrary good quality.

pools.label: URINARY_HARM
pools.reason: Manifest harmful urinary consequence differs from the explicitly opposed urinary benefit and generic BAD.

pools.label: DESCRIBED_OR_ANAPHORIC_PEDANTS
pools.reason: Conservative group-reference safety pool: described human group P versus anaphoric P. Their lexical descriptive/antecedent requirements remain different; the pool is not justified as proven equality merely by their eventual reference to P.

pools.label: INSIST_CALL
pools.reason: Paid composite advocated naming content with group/plant/Name arguments; neither INSIST nor USE_NAME alone preserves the whole.

pools.label: RHAPHANOS
pools.reason: Name constant t, not the active-antecedent SAME_NAME operation or the plant to which a group applies that name.

pools.label: AS_IF
pools.reason: Nonfactual rhetorical comparison, not factual cause, ordinary negation, or customary practice.

pools.label: SPEAK
pools.reason: Speaking relation does not include reportability, advocacy, or the specific three-place naming content of USE_NAME.

pools.label: CURRENT_GREEKS
pools.reason: Both entries explicitly preserve the same source-present community G at tau0.

pools.label: ATHENIANS
pools.reason: Time-indexed A(t), not source-present Greek community G; overlap of persons would not identify the full values.

pools.label: SIX_HUNDRED_YEARS_AGO
pools.reason: Fixed source-relative interval/deictic modifier, not a group referent or unspecific time reference.

pools.label: ALL
pools.reason: Universal claim over a supplied group and predicate, not a two-place conjunction or a pair referent.

pools.label: SAME_NAME
pools.reason: Requires an active Name antecedent; do not replace this full operation by its evaluated RHAPHANOS result.

pools.label: CUSTOMARILY
pools.reason: Customary practice claim is not the explicitly contrasted advocated practice of INSIST or bare USE_NAME content.

pools.label: USE_NAME
pools.reason: Structured name-use content; actuality and advocacy are supplied outside it. Distinct from INSIST_CALL and generic SPEAK.

pools.label: OTHER_PLANT
pools.reason: Contextual R distinct from C, not a chosen named constant or a food/vegetable deixis; edibility is unasserted.

pools.label: INSIST
pools.reason: Advocatory operator on a proposition, not actual customary usage or the composite INSIST_CALL.
